description: Retrieval evaluation set for the Enjaz corpus. Each question is one a project manager could plausibly ask, tagged with the document(s) that genuinely contain the answer. Written by reading the indexed markdown, not by guessing from filenames. Questions are NOT tuned to make the score look good — a question is only corrected when the answer is genuinely absent from the tagged document, never because it turned out to be hard.

questions.question: ما هي أعلى المخاطر المسجلة في المشروع وما درجة خطورتها؟
questions.note: The register scores each risk probability x impact on a 1-5 scale.

questions.question: من هو مدير المشروع ومن الجهة الراعية له؟
